summary: Nomad Foods Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Board declared a $0.17/share quarterly cash dividend payable May 28, 2026 to holders of record May 12, 2026. This is a routine capital-return event, not a special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer's current report of an ordinary dividend declaration, with no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. No deal terms apply.
